subject: Billing channel sync: Hemera Health transition to Azure & GCP marketplaces
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Vikram Singh <vikram.singh@hemerahealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@hemerahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing channel sync: Hemera Health transition to Azure & GCP marketplaces

Hi Vikram / Priya,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — great to hear Hemera is open to moving the subscription to marketplace billing for the next renewal. To keep the procurement team happy and preserve your committed unit pricing, I put together a short migration checklist and the current SOW so we can map entitlements and any proration.

Attachments: Hemera_Marketplace_Migration_Checklist.pdf (2 pages); Hemera_SOW_v3.pdf

High-level asks from our side: 
- Confirm target cutover window (you mentioned "early June" in the call).
- Confirm whether Hemera requires a PO to the marketplace subscription or would accept a DocuSign amendment + marketplace route.
- Any procurement constraints around retaining committed spend for eligibility to your internal budget (we can do proration credits where needed).

If you can confirm those three items I'll coordinate with our marketplace ops and Aditya on entitlements & seller-of-record details.

Next step: I can prepare an amendment for signature and a proposed subscription activation timeline once procurement confirms the PO path.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
log[email redacted] | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Vikram Singh <vikram.singh@hemerahealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@hemerahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing channel sync: Hemera Health transition to Azure & GCP marketplaces

Thanks Logan — quick answers: 

- Cutover: early June still works; preferred window June 7-11.
- Procurement: We typically need a PO for marketplace purchases (legal requires a PO reference). If you can provide an amendment that quotes the marketplace subscription and we can reference it on the PO, that should be acceptable.
- Committed spend: We want to keep the same committed units and pricing for the remainder of the term; happy to discuss proration/credit but Hemera finance prefers minimal juggling.

I'll loop in finance if we need to dig into proration but for now please prepare the amendment + a short note we can attach to the PO with the subscription GUID.

-Vikram
Vikram Singh
Director, Procurement | Hemera Health
vikram.singh@hemerahealth.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hemera billing cutover — proration & marketplace routing (need approval)

Marissa / Mina — forwarding the procurement reply from Vikram. Hemera wants to keep committed units & pricing. They require a PO reference for the marketplace subscription, and want the cutover in the week of June 7.

Two asks: 
1) Can we offer a proration credit that preserves their effective committed unit price through the current term? If yes, what's the recommended math (simple prorate vs. credit + top-up)?
2) Who should be seller-of-record for the Azure route? If we set up as marketplace subscription we will need the SOR and the subscription GUID to attach to their PO.

I ran quick numbers locally: assuming cutover June 9 and a 10-month remaining term, the prorated credit to avoid double-billing looks like ~$18.2k (we'll finalize). If we need to keep committed price, we'll need a credit + subscription activation that doesn't drop them below commitment.

Attachments: Hemera_Marketplace_Migration_Checklist.pdf

If you can reply with the preferred approach I'll draft the DocuSign amendment and the (short) procurement note Vikram asked for. Prefer to get approvals this week so Aditya can start entitlement mapping.

—Logan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hemera billing cutover — proration & marketplace routing (need approval)

Thanks Logan — good summary. Approvals below: 

1) Proration: approve a credit that preserves Hemera's effective committed unit price for the remaining term. Finance prefers a straight prorate credit to avoid downstream accounting complications; the $18.2k estimate sounds reasonable as an interim working number. We'll finalize once Mina runs the exact ledger calc.

2) Seller-of-record: for Azure we will route as "Redwood Inference (SaaS via Azure Marketplace)" with our marketplace SOR. Aditya — please confirm entitlement GUID process and whether we need a partner registration for Hemera on the Azure side.

Action items: 
- Mina to produce final proration credit amount and journal entry guidance.
- Aditya to start entitlement mapping and confirm marketplace activation flow + subscription GUID delivery timeline.
- Logan to prepare amendment + procurement note and send to Vikram for PO attachment.

I'll OK a one-time channel offset (up to 7% of the migration value) to cover marketplace fees if that helps keep Hemera whole. Please include that in the amendment if applicable.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Vikram Singh <vikram.singh@hemerahealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@hemerahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing channel sync: Hemera Health transition to Azure & GCP marketplaces — next steps & DocuSign

Hi Vikram / Priya,

Quick update and next steps: 

1) Amendment & DocuSign: I've prepared the amendment that documents the marketplace subscription, the agreed proration credit approach, and the 7% one-time channel offset Marissa approved. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/HEMERA/AMEND-4582 (attached as Hemera_Amendment_DocuSign_link.txt)

2) Procurement note / PO guidance: I'll send a one-page procurement note that includes the subscription GUID and the text Hemera can reference on the PO. Once signed, we will route the subscription to Azure Marketplace with Redwood as SOR and provide the GUID to Vikram for PO attachment.

3) Timeline: target activation week June 7-11. Aditya, please confirm entitlement mapping ETA (cc'd). Mina will follow up with the final ledger entry for the proration credit next week.

If that aligns, please sign the DocuSign amendment and confirm whether Hemera will raise the PO referencing the subscription GUID or if you prefer we create an invoice to be cleared by PO. Either path works, just let us know which Hemera procurement prefers.

Thanks — looking forward to making this smooth.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Hemera_Amendment_DocuSign_link.txt
